GraceChangeDesignContext.Rationale: This package closes audit finding F06. Admission-time checks and handle revocation are insufficient when asynchronous work can reach a privileged sink later.

Alternatives.Alternative: Require each provider to poll cancellation. Rejected because cancellation is cooperative and cannot enforce authority at a commit boundary.
Kill the provider process on every revoke. Rejected because in-process and shared providers exist and process death still cannot undo escaped effects.

DeferredDecisions.Decision: The concrete token representation and caching strategy are deferred to planning after profiling current broker and sink paths.
Per-domain target validation belongs to later broker packages.

Scenarios.Scenario: A feature is revoked while waiting for browser input; its resumed call fails before navigation commit.
A network request was dispatched before crash and no response was recorded; recovery exposes Incomplete and requires explicit reconciliation.
